name: xai/grok-tts
description: Grok Tts by xAI - convert text to natural-sounding speech with AI. Supports multiple voices, languages, emotions, and speaking styles for content creation and accessibility.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to convert to speech. Maximum 15,000 characters. Supports speech tags for expressive delivery: inline tags like [laugh], [pause], [sigh] and wrapping tags like <whisper>text</whisper>, <slow>text</slow>.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice to use for speech synthesis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# xAI Text to Speech

xAI text-to-speech with five voices (Eve, Ara, Rex, Sal, Leo).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | — | Text to speak. |
| `voice` | `eve` / `ara` / `rex` / `sal` / `leo` | — | Voice. |

## Billing

$0.015 per started 1,000 characters, with a one-unit minimum.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 200 characters | $0.015 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.015 |
| 2,500 characters | $0.045 |

Failed runs are not charged.
